title: Bangkok Phuket Krabi | FREE 4 Island Tour In Krabi
highlights: Get amazed by the 'City of Angels', Bangkok and experience its vibrant streets, floating markets and many more
Admire the surrounding with powdery sand, and the blue waters of Maya Bay, featured in the movie “The Beach.”
Visit Patong Beach with its international standard nightclubs, street performances, games, live music and so much more.
Try various kind of adventurous water sports like snorkelling, windsurfing, diving and so much more.
Explore the natural wonders along with lush greenery during your journey to Krabi islands.

Witness Thailand's culture and traditions while witnessing Bangkok's famous landmarks as you cruise through Chao Phraya River.
.
overview:
About the Tour:
From the picturesque white sand beaches like Railay to the ancient relics, Thailand is indeed the perfect destination for a fun-filled vacation. The sweet taste of much-famed nightlife, the delicious cuisine of Chiang Mai and the thrill of unique water sports make this place a must-visit destination. Whether you spend your time witnessing the architectural brilliance of renowned temples of Wat Pho or Wat Phra Kaew, stroll around barefoot on the stretches of white sandy beaches fringed with casuarinas and palms, getting a sweet taste of Phuket after sundown at Soi Bangla or an adventurous excursion to Phi Phi Island, this tour has everything for a perfect getaway in the tropical paradise.


Quick info:
Destinations Covered: Bangkok, Phuket, Krabi
Duration: 8 Days, 7 Nights
Start Point: Bangkok International Airport
End Point: Krabi International Airport
inclusions: Transfer from Suvarnabhumi Airport to Deluxe Hotel
2 nights stay in Bangkok with breakfast
Full Day Bangkok City Tour on a Private basis
Chao Phraya Princess Dinner Cruise in Bangkok - Dinner Cruise Ticket with International Buffet at ICONSIAM Pier on a Private basis
Transfer from Deluxe Hotel to Don Mueang International Airport
Transfer from Phuket International Airport to Deluxe Hotel
3 nights stay in Phuket with breakfast
Phi Phi Island Tour from Phuket - Phi Phi island with lunch by Big Boat/Ferry on a Private basis
Phuket City Tour - Phuket City Tour on a Shared basis
3 nights stay in Krabi with breakfast
Krabi 4 Islands Tour with Speedboat - Private Day Tour with Long tail Boat on a Shared basis
Transfer from Deluxe Hotel to Krabi Airport
exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
know_before_you_go: International/ domestic flights are not included in the package price.
Visa assistance will be provided but the price is not included in the package.
Please carry valid IDs and Thrillophilia Voucher.
Please note that prices are dynamic and may change in the peak season and on blackout dates.
Please do not litter and keep destination clean
Mandatory RT-PCR negative test report (The test should have been conducted within 72 hrs prior to departure from India)
The Thailand Pass is required when travelling to Thailand by air and is not included in the package.

Upon arrival in Thailand, travellers will need to stay for 1 night in an ASQ or SHA+ Hotel while they wait for the COVID 19 RT-PCR test result that was taken upon arrival and another stay for 1 night in an ASQ or SHA+ hotel on Day 5 of their visit.
An Individual must be Fully Vaccinated before the Date of Departure to Thailand. Unvaccinated children below 18 years old may travel with vaccinated parents.

As per Indian Govt. Rules, a Tax Collection at Source (TCS) of 5% for Foreign Remittance shall be paid additionally that you can claim while filing the income tax returns. Consult a tax advisor/consultant for further information.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Half Day City Tour of Phuket
days.desc: Get transferred for a half-day city tour of Phuket. Enjoy shopping at the Souvenir Market. Visit to the Karon View Point to enjoy the views of Kata Noi, Kata Yai, and Karon beaches, followed by a visit to Wat Chalong Temple. Later, get transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Krabi
days.desc: Post-checkout from your hotel, get transferred to your pre-booked hotel in Krabi. Check-in, and spend the rest of the day at leisure. You can rent a boat from Krabi town or Ao Nang and explore the islands on your own. Later, head back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Krabi 4 Island Tour
days.desc: Get transferred to Railay Beach for your Krabi 4 Island tour. Hop on a shared speedboat to Koh Poda Island. Later, you will also visit Chicken Island and Phranang Cave Beach. After the tour, get transferred from Krabi Pier to the hotel for an overnight stay.
